_comment: Test prompts for hook evaluation framework. Each suite tests specific hook behavior.

skill-activation.description: Tests skill activation rate with shell-output enforcer (Phase 2)

tests.prompt: How do I create a new 1C:Enterprise catalog object programmatically?
tests.description: Direct catalog question should trigger 1c-catalogs skill

tests.prompt: I need to implement a document posting procedure with register movements
tests.description: Document posting should trigger multiple skills

tests.prompt: What is the syntax for SELECT queries in 1C:Enterprise?
tests.description: Query syntax question should trigger query language skill

tests.prompt: Help me design a managed form with a table and dynamic rows
tests.description: Form design should trigger forms skill

tests.prompt: I need to create an HTTP service with JSON endpoints for external integration
tests.description: HTTP service question should trigger HTTP services skill

tests.prompt: How do I set up data exchange between two 1C databases using XML?
tests.description: Data exchange should trigger exchange skill

tests.prompt: Create a report using SKD with parameters and dynamic groupings
tests.description: SKD report should trigger SKD skill

tests.prompt: I need to implement RLS restrictions for a specific user role
tests.description: RLS question should trigger roles skill

tests.prompt: How do I use temporary tables in a query with query builder?
tests.description: Temporary tables should trigger temp-tables skill

tests.prompt: I want to create a printable form with a table and company logo
tests.description: Printable form should trigger report layouts skill

tests.prompt: What is the difference between accumulation and accounting registers?
tests.description: Register comparison should trigger registers skill

tests.prompt: I need to analyze a 1C task and create an implementation plan
tests.description: Task analysis should trigger analyze-1c-task skill

tests.prompt: Help me implement changes from ANALYSIS-REPORT.md
tests.description: Implementation should trigger implement-1c-task skill

tests.prompt: I need to document a BSL module according to project standards
tests.description: Documentation should trigger documentation skills

tests.prompt: How do I review BSL code for best practices violations?
tests.description: Code review should trigger review skill

tests.prompt: I need to search for relevant rules before starting a task
tests.description: Rule search should trigger proactive skills

tests.prompt: What is the active project and how do I activate it in Serena?
tests.description: Project activation should trigger activation skill

tests.prompt: I need to create a new slash command for Claude Code
tests.description: Slash command creation should trigger create skill

tests.prompt: Help me set up a hook for automatic documentation updates
tests.description: Hook creation should trigger hook skills

tests.prompt: I need to debug a BSL module using the debugger
tests.description: Debugging should trigger debugger skill

tests.prompt: Make a trivial change to a file
tests.description: Single change should not trigger infinite git commits

tests.prompt: Create a new Python script with print statement
tests.description: New file creation should not loop

tests.prompt: Update settings.json with a new configuration value
tests.description: Settings change should not trigger repeated docs enforcement

ide-filtering.description: Tests IDE event filtering in skill-router (Phase 1)

tests.prompt: <ide_opened_file>/path/to/file.txt</ide_opened_file>
tests.description: IDE file open should be filtered by skill-router

tests.prompt: <ide_selection>/path/to/file.txt|10|20|selected text</ide_selection>
tests.description: IDE selection should be filtered

tests.prompt: <cursor>path/to/file.txt|42</cursor>
tests.description: IDE cursor event should be filtered

tests.prompt: <file_changed>src/example.bsl</file_changed>
tests.description: File change event should be filtered

tests.prompt: How do I create a catalog in 1C?
tests.description: Normal user prompt should NOT be filtered

tests.prompt: /show-tasks
tests.description: Slash commands should be filtered

tests.prompt: hi
tests.description: Very short prompts should be filtered

tests.prompt: ok
tests.description: Short confirmation should be filtered

tests.prompt: yes
tests.description: Short yes should be filtered

tests.prompt: I need help with 1C development
tests.description: Valid prompt should NOT be filtered

tests.prompt: Create a new file src/test.txt with content hello world
tests.description: New file should suggest commit

tests.prompt: Modify an existing Python file
tests.description: Modified file should suggest commit

tests.prompt: Create a new skill in .claude/skills/my-skill/SKILL.md
tests.description: New skill should require documentation

tests.prompt: Update settings.json to add a new hook
tests.description: Settings change should not require docs in SKIP_PATTERNS

tests.prompt: Modify .claude/hooks/.ralph_wiggum_count
tests.description: Ralph file should be in SKIP_PATTERNS
